title: Input OTP
api:
type InputOTPProps = Omit<
  InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>,
  'size' | 'value' | 'defaultValue' | 'onChange' | 'maxLength' | 'type' | 'inputMode' | 'pattern'
> & {
  length?: number
  value?: string
  defaultValue?: string
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void
  onComplete?: (value: string) => void
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
  loading?: boolean
  previewState?: UIState
}
notes: InputOTP uses one real input with visual slots. Preserve its paste, numeric filtering and one-time-code autofill behavior; do not rebuild separate slot inputs.
onComplete reports input completion, not successful authentication. Verify codes on your server and handle resend/rate limiting in the application.
